description: Republican politicians or party officials commenting on, analyzing, or reacting to the results of the midterm elections.
who: Elected Republican officials (Presidents, Senators, Representatives, Governors, Mayors), Republican Party leadership (RNC chair, committee chairs), prominent Republican activists, or commentators explicitly identified as Republican strategists/analysts. Does not include Democrats, independents, or neutral news anchors unless quoting a Republican.
what: The outcome of the midterm elections, specifically seat counts, control of Congress, specific wins/losses, or the overall performance of the party. Reactions can be positive (celebrating wins) or negative (explaining losses).
exclude_sources: Live election night coverage where the results are still being tabulated and no final outcome has been declared for the specific district/nation.
Campaign ads or candidate speeches from before the election.
General political commentary not directly tied to the specific results of the 2026 midterm.
Videos that are primarily about the 2024 or 2028 elections unless explicitly comparing them to the 2026 results.
interpretation: This spec targets statements made by Republicans *after* the results of the 2026 midterms were known. It assumes 'midterm results' refers to the November 2026 election cycle given the current date. It excludes live coverage of the election night before results are finalized, focusing instead on post-election analysis, celebration, or post-mortems.
